surveys.name: Institutional Characteristics
surveys.reason: Requires an institution_profile domain for address, control, calendar, mission, and award-level metadata.

surveys.name: Completions
surveys.reason: Governed completion, student demographic, program, CIP, and award-level data are available.

surveys.name: 12-Month Enrollment
surveys.reason: Unduplicated headcount is derivable, but governed instructional contact-hour data are missing.

surveys.name: Cost
surveys.reason: Requires tuition, fee, cost-of-attendance, and net-price source domains.

surveys.name: Admissions
surveys.reason: Requires applicant, admit, enrolled, and test-score funnel data.

surveys.name: Graduation Rates
surveys.reason: Cohorts are derivable, but official exclusions and transfer-out rules are not implemented.

surveys.name: 200% Graduation Rates
surveys.reason: Cohorts are derivable, but official 200%-time exclusions and transfer-out rules are not implemented.

surveys.name: Outcome Measures
surveys.reason: Requires governed 4-, 6-, and 8-year cohort tracking joined to Pell and loan status.

surveys.name: Student Financial Aid
surveys.reason: A Pell-recipient field is now modeled, but award amounts, aid categories, and reconciliation rules are not yet complete.

surveys.name: Fall Enrollment
surveys.reason: Parts A, B, D, and H are generated from governed fall census data; Parts C, E, F, and G remain blocked on missing governed fields.

surveys.name: Finance
surveys.reason: Requires a governed general-ledger/chart-of-accounts source domain.

surveys.name: Human Resources
surveys.reason: Requires occupational category, tenure, salary, and employee demographic fields.

retired.name: Academic Libraries
retired.reason: NCES retired the Academic Libraries survey component beginning with the 2025-26 collection.
